scope: Review-only portable base HTNPlanner method snapshot engineering
verification: One isolated source-trio run, no full app bootstrap; source hashes checked before and after. Synthetic fixtures only. Plugin autoload and bytecode disabled. Wall timeout60s, CPU30s, address-space512MiB, per-file output cap5MiB.
warning_detail: Built-in pytest cache attempted writes under /dev because config was /dev/null. Both writes were permission-denied. Future isolated commands should disable cacheprovider. No rerun was used to hide warnings.
limits: No main merge, deployment, full integration, Python3.12, AGI, or research-performance claim.
Import supports exact base HTNPlanner only; durable subclasses are rejected.
Subclass export omits review status. Proposed durable methods could be transferred to an ungated base planner, so this is not production review-safe portability.
Runtime snapshots remain private data; goal text and arguments are not publication-safe merely because authority fields are cleared.
Counters and scope labels are data claims, not authenticated history or execution permission.
No universal nested-input resource or semantic-correctness guarantee.
